text.en: The sitios of San Miguel, Arasan, New Cuyo, Salvacion and Narra in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, are converted into barrios of said municipality, to be known as the barrios of San Miguel, Arasan, New Cuyo, Salvacion and Narra, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
